how.step1Copy: Start with buy, rent, or list. We only ask for the detail that intent needs — nothing more.
how.step2Copy: Location, budget, and amenities narrow the shortlist. Nearest-first results come from real coordinates, not guesswork.
how.step3Copy: Every listing shows who verified it, when, and what was checked — identity, location, photos, video, and documents.
how.step4Copy: Chat on-platform, make an offer, and get a permanent receipt the moment the agent accepts.
home.whyCopy: Most platforms let anyone upload anything. ChiChoc-Habitat physically verifies the property, the media, and the person behind it — then keeps an immutable record of the review.
home.howCopy: The verification layer runs underneath every step, so you never have to take a listing on faith.

kyc.title: Identity verification
kyc.headline: Get verified to list.
kyc.intro: Takes about six minutes. Nothing is published until our team reviews and approves this application.
kyc.step.identity.title: Identity document
kyc.step.liveness.title: Face liveness
kyc.step.liveness.copy: Confirm the person matches the document.
kyc.step.address.title: Proof of address
kyc.step.address.copy: A recent utility bill or bank statement.
kyc.step.review.title: Review & submit
kyc.step.review.copy: Confirm everything before sending to review.
kyc.id.title: Upload your ID
kyc.id.copy: Use a plain background with all four corners visible. We never share this document with agents or customers.
kyc.id.encrypted: Encrypted at rest with AES-256. Only the verification team can open it.
kyc.face.title: Face liveness
kyc.face.copy: Hold the camera at eye level and follow the prompt. Recording happens here — there is no gallery upload.
kyc.face.prompt: Look at the camera, then blink
kyc.face.pending: Nothing leaves this device until you confirm
kyc.address.title: Proof of address
kyc.address.copy: Dated within the last three months. A utility bill, bank statement, or lease agreement all work.
kyc.address.hint: Required for commercial and hospitality listings.
kyc.review.title: Review and submit
kyc.review.copy: A reviewer usually responds within one business day.
kyc.review.consent: I confirm the documents are mine and consent to the verification checks described in the trust policy.
kyc.fileHint: JPG, PNG or PDF · max 10 MB
capture.stampNote: Each shot is stamped with GPS and time, then sealed. It cannot be replaced later.

capture.moveCloser: Move closer to the property to unlock capture
capture.vaultNote: Photos are written to the secure vault immediately. This device keeps no copy.
capture.whyCopy: Capture is blocked unless you are physically at the property, so a listing can never be built from stock photos.
